parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: Required for idempotent scenarios. A UUID-generated string. This field is used for idempotence. If the same value is passed in multiple calls, the result of the first call is returned.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: Required for unsubscription scenarios. The instance ID.

parameters.name: ProductCode
parameters.description: Required for unsubscription scenarios. The product code.

parameters.name: ProductType
parameters.description: Required for unsubscription scenarios. The product type. Pass an empty string ("") unless otherwise specified.
